snippet.title: Mutants vs The Chosen: Traitor
snippet.description: Just a very short look at the second part of the Mutants vs The Chosen game serie - named Traitor. It is a point-and-click adventure game for smartphones and tablets with Android, where you help Riam, the main hero, to defend mutants against the Chosen ones.
